description: Released semantic error treatment remains a regression invariant (REQ-028; C55, G23; R22; AC-C55-01, AC-R028-01; JOURNEY-028). PR611's released correction (library pilot c0d5782 / 55843bd, proved by e2e/library-error-role.spec.ts) is retained, not reimplemented, in the one shared owner src/ui/view-state.tsx#ErrorView (unchanged by this task, byte-identical to accepted reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d): the alert root scopes --border-card and --brd to --border-toast-negative so a standalone failure's frame, accent bar and emission share the error role in every skin, and the AlertTriangle glyph paints --icon-toast-negative; inside a card the failure is that card's content. The accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=errors is added over the same owner (src/dev/gallery-refinement-errors.tsx), with no route CSS. check-01 pins the DOM contract, the real route guard's account-load error and its Try again, the gallery state, one owner and no restating stylesheet, and the existing error/retry meaning cases; check-02 proves on the real app (boot account-load failure and /summary's session failure, contained synthetic session, nothing written) and the gallery state in all four skins that the painted roles match, plus loading/error/retry meanings, keyboard, touch, reduced motion and one-shot motion. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-028 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/view-state.test.tsx --testNamePattern "error|retry" --passWithNoTests=false

cases.name: reference screen: error > renders the AppError as an alert: plain message, requestId, what failed
reference screen: error > the retry action re-runs the failed operation
containment: a state never puts a card inside a card > an error without a retry offers no action rather than a dead one

TASK-028 released error role (C55, R22) > AC-C55-01 a standalone error scopes both border hooks to the error role at its root, so its frame, accent bar and emission share one role, and the glyph paints the error icon role

TASK-028 released error role (C55, R22) > AC-C55-01 an error inside a card is that card’s content: the root keeps the error hooks, the glyph keeps the error icon role and no second frame, bar or emission is drawn
TASK-028 released error role (C55, R22) > AC-C55-01 a real route’s account-load error renders the shared error owner with its role, and Try again re-reads the account into the route
TASK-028 released error role (C55, R22) > AC-C55-01 the accepted gallery state ?state=errors draws the shared error owner: a network timeout with the error role and its Retry

TASK-028 released error role (C55, R22) > AC-R028-01 error owner retained: PR611’s correction stays in the one shared ErrorView, no second error owner or stylesheet restates the role, and the pilot’s regression proof is in place
